messages:
ella: Hey team — got a weird calendar invite titled 'Invoice Review' from 'Acme Billing'. There was an .ics attached and an event link that asked me to sign in to view details. I clicked accept by mistake but did NOT enter any creds. Organizer shows acme-billing@mailer.ru. Should I be worried?

sam (sec): Don't enter any creds. Thanks for flagging. Can you DM me a screenshot of the invite + the raw organizer email header? Also revoke the acceptance for that event (open event -> "More actions -> Delete"), and sign out of the calendar just in case.

ella: DM sent — screenshot + copied header. Organizer domain looks funky: acme-billing[.]mailer.ru. Event link preview is https://calendar-accept.example-redirect[.]com/verify?ev=abc123

triage-bot: Submitted artifact to sandbox (id: sbx-20260315-87). Verdict: malicious — credential harvesting redirect. Network trace: POST to https://api.example-redirect[.]com/auth with form fields 'email' and 'password'. Dropped payload contains base64-encoded HTML form. Indicators: domain example-redirect[.]com, IP 198.51.100.23. Recommended action: block domain/IP, remove event from affected accounts, search for similar invites.

anita (sec): Good catch. I'm initiating containment: 1) Blocked example-redirect[.]com at the web gateway and org blocklist. 2) Added acme-billing@mailer.ru to blocked senders in Workspace. 3) Ran Workspace audit for calendar.accept events over last 48h and starting force reauth for anyone who accepted invites from that domain.

sam (sec): Can we also rotate any service account tokens that have calendar write permissions? I pushed a request to IT to rotate the integration token used by our internal org-sync service. @it-helpdesk can you confirm rotation ETA?

it-helpdesk: Confirmed. Rotating token now, ETA ~15m. Will also revoke any suspicious OAuth grants for 'Calendar API (internal-sync)'.

anita (sec): Creating a saved Cloud Audit Logs query: filter protoPayload.methodName=\"v1.calendar.events.accept\" AND protoPayload.request.organizerEmail: \"mailer.ru\" — will post results in this thread.

ella: Thanks. One odd thing — the event had a calendar attachment that scheduled a Zoom link. I didn't click Zoom. Is there a follow-up we should expect?

sam (sec): If you didn't enter credentials, likely limited to attempted harvest. Still treat as credential exposure risk if SSO cookies were active. We're forcing SSO sessions to expire for affected users as a precaution.\n\npeople-ops: We'll draft a targeted awareness note for the company in the next hour: quick steps to remove suspicious invites, check oauth grants, and how to report. Also adding an FAQ entry to the handbook.

anita (sec): Post-incident actions: 1) KB page 'suspicious-calendar-invite' created (link internal/doc/si-2026-calendar). 2) Run a mailbox scan for similar organizer domains across the org. 3) Set up SIEM alert for calendar event creations from external organizers containing attachments/urls. 4) Schedule a 20min blameless recap with the affected user to capture lessons.

sam (sec): For tracking, I'm opening an internal incident (INC-2026-041) with timeline and containment steps. Please add any further findings there.

ella: Appreciate the quick help. Quick Q: should I rotate my password even though I didn't enter creds?

anita (sec): Recommended: rotate if you have auto-signed-in sessions (SSO) active in the browser you used. If you can, sign out of Google and reauth. If not sure, change password and enable a session revoke from account settings. We'll follow up via DM with specifics. :white_check_mark:

sam (sec): TL;DR actions completed: sandbox verdict confirmed, web gateway block applied, blocked sender, token rotation in progress, saved audit query added, awareness comms drafted. Leaving monitoring alerts for 24h and will escalate if we see further hits.

triage-bot: Sandbox report attached to incident INC-2026-041. IOC list: example-redirect[.]com, acme-billing[.]mailer.ru, 198.51.100.23.

people-ops: Awareness note sent to all-eng with steps + link to KB. We'll ping security if we need additional wording. :mailbox_with_mail:

anita (sec): Closing out the thread here — follow-ups in INC-2026-041 and the KB. Thanks @ella for reporting quickly.
